title: A Mui Ne day: white dunes, then the red slope
summary: Leave the Ham Tien strip in the dark for Bàu Trắng. The adventure page says be on the pale sand from 5:00 to 7:00. Use the afternoon wind on the beach, then the red dunes at sunset. Phan Thiet is the city you pass, not a second base.

days.title: Dawn field, afternoon wind, sunset slope
days.body: The white-dune morning replaces the harbor. Vietnam Tourism’s adventure page says set an alarm for 4:30 if an ATV at sunrise is the plan, and be at Bàu Trắng from 5:00 to 7:00. The must-do page prints a 25 km drive. The adventure page prints a short drive from the main beach strip. Both stay. Come back to the Ham Tien sand for the kite window the adventure page puts at 11:00–16:00. The must-do page says the morning wind is gentler, and the sports page says the breeze is year-round. At the end of the day, the red slope: Vietnam Tourism says just outside town at sunset, and the 2019 ministry page says about 22 km from the Phan Thiet city center. Fees and the minutes from a resort gate are Check on arrival.

stops.name: White dunes
stops.note: The 120 minutes are the 5:00–7:00 window on the adventure page, not a timed walk. A 25 km drive and a short drive from the strip both stay. The fee is Check on arrival.

approach.note: Vietnam Tourism also names a motorbike for the dunes. Minutes from the strip are Check on arrival.

stops.name: Ham Tien sand
stops.note: The 300 minutes are the adventure page’s kite window, 11:00–16:00, October to April. The must-do page says the morning is gentler. The sports page says the breeze is year-round. A lesson fee is Check on arrival.

approach.note: This stop is the strip itself if you slept on the sand. Taxi and bicycle fares are Check on arrival.

stops.name: Red dunes
stops.note: Sunset. A minute count is Check on arrival. About 22 km from the Phan Thiet city center on the 2019 ministry page, and just outside town on the must-do page. The fee is Check on arrival.

approach.note: The 22 km figure is from the city center, not from a resort gate. Minutes from the strip are Check on arrival.
